Class Tester<E extends Testcase>

java.lang.Object
main.Tester<E>
Type Parameters:
E -
Direct Known Subclasses:
ASTTester, DynamicTester
public abstract class Tester<E extends Testcase> extends Object
Wrapper for a Tester allows to save testcases and run them on submissions
